name: Taste-Skill
one_liner: Stops a coding agent from producing the same generic-looking result.

text.why: Leave the interface to an agent and the same familiar default layout keeps coming back. Taste-Skill changes those defaults, adding judgement about what not to produce. It attaches to tools such as Claude Code and Codex and is published under MIT. What counts as a good result is a matter of taste, so whether it matches your team's standard is something to see for yourself.
text.take: A rule set that changes the agent's default look; whether the result matches your taste is yours to judge.
build: A team setting that changes the default look of front-end output
A design exploration step that produces several options quickly

start.text: Add --skill "install name" to pick a single skill
You can also copy SKILL.md into a project or paste it into a chat
